tasks.title: Implement the code change
tasks.instructions: Make the smallest complete change. Add a focused regression test that fails before the change. Run only that test file with `/opt/homebrew/bin/python3.11 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_<focused>.py`.

criteria.title: Focused pytest check
criteria.description: A focused regression check fails before the implementation and passes afterward. Run one test file only: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.11 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_<focused>.py.

criteria.title: Implementation behavior
criteria.description: The requested behavior is implemented and the focused check covers the changed contract.
